en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from the one who mentioned it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade cross the line (of the camels).
So it was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! And why?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is none from the line except and what is between the camel to the camel is a Satan<sup>la</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, prohibited to cross and intersect the row of camels.
Someone asked, ‘Why is this, O Messenger of Allah?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘In every row of camels between every two camels there is a Satan.’”
